tools.name: akulacyber_search_products
tools.description: Search the AkulaCyber catalogue (GL.iNet Comet KVM over IP devices and their accessories) and return matching products with current price in UAH, availability and page URL. Without a query it returns the whole catalogue (9 products). Use akulacyber_get_product for full details of one product.

tools.name: akulacyber_get_product
tools.description: Return one product from the AkulaCyber catalogue: current price in UAH and availability, description, specifications, comparable facts (for KVMs), compatible accessories or KVMs, photos and the product page URL where the buyer orders. A product photo comes with the result; cart_url opens the store c

tools.name: akulacyber_compare_kvms
tools.description: Compare two to six GL.iNet Comet KVM over IP models side by side: computers controlled, video, Ethernet, PoE, Wi-Fi, cellular, HDMI out, screen, power, size and weight, with current price in UAH. Accessories are not compared; use akulacyber_get_product for them.

tools.name: akulacyber_find_delivery_points
tools.description: Find Nova Poshta branches and parcel lockers in a Ukrainian city where an AkulaCyber order can be delivered, from the directory the checkout uses. If the city name matches several places, the result lists them; call again with city_ref. At most 30 points are returned; more_points true means the city

tools.name: akulacyber_cart_link
tools.description: Return a link that opens the AkulaCyber store cart with the chosen products and quantities already in it, with current prices in UAH. The buyer opens the link, checks the cart and places the order on the site (delivery and payment are chosen at checkout); nothing is ordered or reserved by this tool.

tools.name: akulacyber_delivery_estimate
tools.description: Say whether an order placed now ships today and when Nova Poshta usually delivers it, from the store's delivery terms and the current time in Kyiv. Orders paid by bank transfer ship once the money arrives; public holidays (cut-off 16:30) are not taken into account. Dates are Kyiv dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: akulacyber_get_store_policy
tools.description: Return one of the store pages as text: delivery and payment, warranty and returns, public offer (terms of sale), privacy policy, or about the store (seller details and contacts).
